allocation_finalized.description: Committed and finalized inventory allocations, typically locked for outbound operations like picking or shipping.

conditions.join: t_pick_detail on t_allocation.wh_id = t_pick_detail.wh_id WHERE t_pick_detail.order_number = ''

allocation_picking.description: Allocations specific to picking processes in outbound workflows, supporting zone and task-based inventory picking.

allocation_strategy.description: Details allocation strategy logic used, including FIFO, FEFO, and rule-based allocations used to prioritize inventory.

allocation_attributes.description: Attributes tied to inventory allocation, such as lot control, storage constraints, or hold reasons preventing allocation.

allocation_queue_status.description: Tracks inventory allocation tasks that are queued, pending, in-progress, or completed. Used for real-time and dynamic allocation monitoring.

allocation_task_planning.description: Details prioritization of allocation tasks including workforce requirements and work type overrides for warehouse planning.

allocation_wave_load.description: Information about wave and load-based grouping of allocation tasks to facilitate efficient planning and warehouse execution.

allocation_batch_thread.description: Handles batch and thread identifiers for concurrent allocation processing and parallelized task execution in high-throughput environments.

allocation_shipping_window.description: Defines the shipping windows for allocation tasks, helping prioritize and sequence allocations for fulfillment deadlines.

allocation_staging.description: Identifies staging locations involved in queued allocation to facilitate pre-pick consolidation and load preparation.

asn_details.description: Details of an Advance Shipment Notice

asn_detail_management.description: Manages line-item details for Advanced Shipping Notices (ASNs), specifying inbound shipment contents

create_date: CAST(create_date AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

adjustment_summary.description: General information about inventory adjustments during cycle counts, including type, reason, and timestamp.

adjustment_quantity.description: Captures quantity differences identified during cycle count adjustments, including physical vs system quantity.

adjustment_location.description: Tracks the origin and destination locations involved in an inventory adjustment, useful for location-based audits.

adjustment_handling_unit.description: Details the handling units involved in the inventory adjustment, for tracking container-level movements or corrections.

adjustment_employee_tracking.description: Identifies the employee responsible for the adjustment and the work queue task associated with it, supporting traceability.

adjustment_lot_expiry.description: Handles adjustments related to lot-level inventory and expiration dates, crucial for compliance and shelf-life management.

uom_cycle_count_summary.description: Provides multi-UOM item entries used in cycle count reconciliation to ensure consistency across packaging levels in inventory tracking.

uom_counted_quantity.description: Reflects the physical counted quantity during a cycle count, broken down by the relevant unit of measure or packaging level.

uom_conversion_factor.description: Handles conversion logic between units of measure such as each, case, and pallet to normalize counts during inventory reconciliation.

putaway_class_summary.description: Describes the classification of items for storage in the warehouse, supporting putaway and zone compatibility decisions.

putaway_class_hierarchy.description: Defines the primary and overflow class mappings for items, enabling fallback logic when primary storage areas are full.

putaway_targeting.description: Indicates the distribution or priority percentage for item placement during putaway operations within warehouse zones.

putaway_special_handling.description: Represents special storage requirements such as hazardous, frozen, or regulatory-sensitive items to ensure compliant and safe storage.

location_class_link.description: Defines the association between item classes and their valid storage locations in the warehouse for compliant putaway operations.

location_fill_strategy.description: Specifies the preferred sequence in which locations should be filled during putaway, replenishment, and slotting processes.

location_storage_constraints.description: Supports storage rules based on compliance, safety, and environmental requirements such as hazardous materials or cold storage zones.

container_basic_info.description: Provides basic metadata for container types used in warehouse operations, such as pallet, carton, or manifest containers.

container_physical_dimensions.description: Captures size and capacity details of containers, including dimensions, volume, and weight-related limits.

container_loading_logic.description: Defines container loading and planning rules, optimization parameters, and strategies for efficient warehouse packing and shipment prep.

container_layering_constraints.description: Describes the rules for layering and stacking items within containers, used in container load modeling and packing logic.

container_cog_limits.description: Defines safe limits for center of gravity shifts in loaded containers, critical for stability in stacking and transport.

container_advanced_constraints.description: Represents structural and spatial constraints applied during container packing, to ensure safe stacking and optimized load distribution.

container_diversity_rules.description: Controls packing diversity rules such as mixing item types, packaging targets, or keeping similar items in one container.

container_class_info.description: Defines container classes used to group container types for specific warehouse operations such as packing or shipping.

container_cartonization_logic.description: Supports logic for selecting appropriate containers based on class during cartonization and packing operations.

container_class_warehouse_use.description: Maps container classes to warehouse-specific configurations to assist in fulfillment, shipping, and pick area optimization.

system_config_core.description: Central configuration entries that transcend fixed logic, enabling default system behaviors across warehouse modules to be dynamically reimagined.

system_feature_toggles.description: Flags and switches that orchestrate feature enablement across the warehouse system, intertwining operational flexibility with modular control.

system_sequence_control.description: Manages sequence counters and background triggers—vital for systems that operate as a labyrinth of interlocking events and job executions.

active_employee.description: Employees currently active in the warehouse

employee_warehouse.description: Employees associated with a specific warehouse

forward_pick_location_item.description: Links warehouse locations with item numbers designated for forward picking, helping define pick face zones and setup strategies.

forward_pick_uom_attributes.description: Captures unit of measure and stored item attributes required for granular pick configuration and dynamic inventory handling.

forward_pick_replenishment_rules.description: Defines replenishment parameters for forward pick locations, ensuring timely refill based on threshold rules and tolerance levels.

forward_pick_priority_logic.description: Controls forward pick logic for priority and replenishment calculations, driving picker routing and order fulfillment efficiency.

inventory_hold_summary.description: Tracks the application and status of inventory holds at the item or storage level to prevent movement or usage until cleared.

hold_reason_and_category.description: Captures the reason or category for placing items on hold—ranging from QA and damage to compliance and return workflows.

held_item_metadata.description: Stores metadata related to the held item, including the associated employee, date of hold creation, and audit tracking information.

handling_units_status.description: Returns a list of Handling Units (LPs) across all warehouses that are marked as unavailable (status = 'U').

handling_units_by_warehouse.description: Returns all Handling Units (LPs) present in a specific warehouse, including details such as status, type, and location.

item_space.description: Items occupying space based on dimensions

item_information.description: Detailed information about a specific item

item_weight.description: Weight of items in a warehouse

item_master_management.description: Manages master data for items, including dimensions, weight, hazardous material flags, and detailed attributes for warehouse operations

uom_identity_and_linkage.description: Defines the relationship between warehouse, item, unit of measure, and class. Foundation for all unit-level logic and ERP mapping.

uom_conversion_and_handling.description: Supports conversion logic, picking/putaway configuration, and quantity thresholds. Key to replenishment, packing, and shipping strategies.

uom_physical_attributes.description: Defines physical characteristics of each UOM, essential for space planning, packing, and containerization logic.

uom_layering_and_stacking.description: Controls how units are layered and stacked within packaging. Enables stable builds and proper weight distribution.

uom_orientation_rules.description: Orientation constraints for warehouse stacking, picking, and containerization—used in safety and packaging compliance.

uom_cartonization_flags.description: Indicates if the UOM is eligible for cartonization logic during order fulfillment and outbound container planning.

random_warehouse_item.description: Returns a random item and its UPC from the warehouse, based on available entries in the t_item_upc table. Useful for sample selections, testing, or audits.

upc_lookup.description: Used to look up items using Universal Product Codes (UPC) for barcode scanning, receiving, and retail integrations.

vendor_item_linkage.description: Maps items to their corresponding vendors, including the vendor-specific item numbers used for purchasing and identification.

vendor_preference_and_pricing.description: Captures procurement-relevant vendor data such as preferred status and vendor-specific pricing for sourcing decisions and PO generation.

vendor_item_master_reference.description: Connects vendor-item relationships to the master item record and warehouse, supporting sourcing logic in supply chain operations.

location_management.description: Manages storage and operational locations within a warehouse, including status and zone assignments

orders_by_carrier.description: Orders shipped by a specific carrier

conditions.shipped_today: CAST(actual_ship_date AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
conditions.created_today: CAST(order_date AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

order_management.description: Manages customer orders, including shipping details, status, priority, and client/warehouse assignments

most_ordered_items.description: Items with the highest order counts in a warehouse

date_expected: CAST(date_expected AS DATE) = CAST(DATEADD(DAY, 1, GETDATE()) AS DATE)

items_not_in_stock.description: Orders with items not in stock

unfulfilled_orders.description: Orders not fulfilled due to items on hold

conditions.shipped_today: qty_shipped > 0 AND CAST(date_expected AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
conditions.arrived_today: CAST(date_expected AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

order_detail_management.description: Manages line-item details for outbound orders, including item quantities, shipping, and order composition

order_line_comment_reference.description: Identifies the order line and item associated with a given comment. Used to tie instructions to specific SKUs in outbound order processing.

order_comment_content_and_type.description: Captures the text and category of line-level comments to communicate shipping, warehouse, or delivery-specific instructions.

order_comment_metadata.description: Tracks sequencing and timestamp of comments for audit trails or to manage instruction priority within order fulfillment.

packages_packed.description: Packages packed in a given time period

packing_activity.description: Tracks packing activities in the warehouse including employee, order, location, and timestamp for audit and operational visibility

recent_packing_summary.description: Provides summary of orders or packages packed within the last hour based on timestamp

employee_packing.description: Maps each packing record to the employee responsible for packing

order_packing_status.description: Indicates whether an order has been packed and when

packing_location.description: Identifies the location within the warehouse where packing occurred

shipped_items.description: Items shipped on a specific date

most_used_container.description: Most used container for orders in a warehouse

active_pick_tasks.description: Tracks all active or ongoing pick tasks based on their status, typically excluding completed, cancelled, or shipped ones.

items_shipped_today.description: Lists items that were shipped today by checking non-zero shipped quantities and filtering by the current date.

pick_performance.description: Captures performance and execution metrics for each pick task by comparing planned, picked, and shipped quantities.

pick_task_assignment.description: Maps pick tasks to assigned users for accountability and performance tracking.

pick_area_routing.description: Defines the sequential order and logical flow of pick areas in a warehouse for orchestrated and optimized picking passes.

tote_movement_and_conveyor_logic.description: Maps tote movement paths via conveyors and PD (pick destinations) to support real-time picking workflows and zone-to-zone transitions.

pick_put_profile_rules.description: Defines the picking, putaway, and replenishment rules associated with specific pick-put profiles. Used to apply business logic to warehouse movement tasks.

rule_execution_sequence.description: Controls the order and type of rules applied during execution. Enables task sequencing and prioritization in warehouse rule engines.

pick_put_profile_core.description: Defines the core identity and description of a pick-put profile used to manage rule-based warehouse operations.

pick_put_profile_hierarchy_and_override.description: Supports hierarchical and override-based rule application for dynamic scenarios like special handling, seasonal logic, or process adjustments.

pick_put_operational_strategy.description: Represents the strategic intent behind a pick-put profile for driving efficient warehouse workflows via rules and task logic.

pick_put_rule_definition.description: Defines warehouse task rules by ID and type. Used to categorize picking, putaway, and replenishment logic for automation and control.

pick_put_procedure_hooks.description: Specifies procedural logic executed before or during task execution. Powers real-time rule-based control of picking, putaway, and replenishment operations.

po_comment_identity.description: Identifies the purchase order and warehouse location associated with the inbound comment record.

po_comment_details.description: Captures the actual comment content, including type, timestamp, and sequence. Used for inbound processing, receiving notes, and logistics coordination.

purchase_order_delivery.description: Delivery details for a purchase order

po_detail_management.description: Manages line-item details for purchase orders, including expected items, quantities, and delivery dates

po_detail_comment_reference.description: Identifies the purchase order line item, warehouse, and item-specific detail the comment is tied to. Enables fine-grained tracking and inspection during inbound receiving.

po_detail_comment_content.description: Stores the content of PO line-level comments with type, timestamp, and sequence information. Useful for vendor instructions, expiry tracking, and operational handling guidance.

po_master_management.description: Manages header-level information for purchase orders, including order type, status, and vendor details

unwaved_last_month_shipments.description: Identifies all shipments that were received last month but have not yet been waved or processed (status still Open). Useful for tracking delays or pending receiving tasks.

shipment_status_tracking.description: Tracks the current status of each shipment (Open, Closed, Reconciled) and its timeline through expected and actual dates.

inbound_appointment_info.description: Provides visibility into inbound appointment scheduling, trailer tracking, and dock operations for expected shipments.

damaged_items.description: Items reported as damaged in receipts

received_items.description: Items received on a specific date

conditions.received_today: CAST(receipt_date AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

receipt_management.description: Tracks receipt transactions for inbound goods, including damaged items and receipt dates

rma_reference_and_order_linkage.description: Identifies the return transaction and links it to the originating orders and warehouse. Essential for processing and tracking RMAs in warehouse workflows.

returned_item_details.description: Captures line-level item details for the return, including quantity, lot tracking, and unit of measure. Supports reconciliation, traceability, and reverse logistics handling.

return_disposition_tracking.description: Tracks the disposition and quality control routing for returned items. Useful for determining the final handling path—restock, destroy, quarantine, etc.

container_identity_and_type.description: Identifies reusable containers such as totes or pallets by number and type. Enables tracking of returnable assets throughout the warehouse and logistics lifecycle.

container_status_and_movement.description: Tracks the current state and last update timestamp of reusable containers. Useful for monitoring in-use vs. returned containers and managing reuse cycles.

container_ownership_and_consignee.description: Captures the customer or consignee responsible for the container, enabling accountability and traceability in returnable container programs.

serial_identity_and_linkage.description: Represents unique serialized inventory identifiers to support item-level traceability and compliance. Enables fine-grained control and tracking of individual units.

serial_inventory_mapping.description: Links each serial number to its respective stored inventory record, enabling end-to-end tracking across warehouse operations, from receiving to shipping.

shipment_identity_and_status.description: Identifies and tracks core shipment data like tracking numbers, order linkage, carrier, and shipping status. Enables integration with carrier APIs for outbound tracking and visibility.

shipment_cost_and_dimensions.description: Captures the financial and dimensional data of a shipment, supporting freight audit, load planning, and charge reconciliation.

alternate_carrier_options.description: Lists fallback carrier options and associated freight costs, used during rate shopping, dynamic routing, or carrier optimization scenarios.

shipment_delivery_details.description: Captures final mile delivery details including status, timestamp, and recipient confirmation. Enables proof of delivery and exception handling in logistics workflows.

returned_order.description: Locations storing items from returned orders

item_quantity_location.description: Quantity of an item in a specific location

old_items.description: Items stored for over a year

random_item.description: Randomly selected item in the warehouse

highest_quantity_item.description: Item with the highest quantity in stock

item_location.description: Locations where a specific item is stored

slow_moving_items.description: Items with low shipment activity in the past quarter

out_of_stock_items.description: Items out of stock in a warehouse

all_items_warehouse.description: All items stored in a specific warehouse

fifo_date: CAST(fifo_date AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

new_items.description: Items newly added to the warehouse

good_quantity_items.description: Items with good quantities in stock

conditions.putaway_pending: put_away_location IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('A', 'H') AND actual_qty > 0
conditions.new_item: CAST(fifo_date AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

stored_item_management.description: Manages current inventory of items stored in warehouse locations, including quantities, locations, statuses, and receipt timing

transaction_core_identity.description: Defines the core identity and timing of a warehouse transaction, including operation type, responsible employee, warehouse, and time duration. Supports audit and activity logging.

transaction_inventory_and_location.description: Captures detailed inventory movement and location data for each transaction. Supports traceability, quality control, and movement validation across the warehouse.

transaction_contextual_references.description: Links transactions to operational references such as orders, kits, waves, and containers. Supports reconciliation with business documents and operational workflows.

transaction_extended_attributes.description: Captures additional metadata for flexible extensions like tracking, routing, carrier info, and grouping. Supports downstream analytics and integration with 3PL or TMS systems.

transaction_type_core.description: Defines standard transaction types for warehouse operations. Each type maps to an action like receiving, shipping, adjustment, or movement, supporting consistent classification across the inventory lifecycle.

transaction_type_system_integration.description: Enables system-level identification and integration, including whether the transaction is routed to external systems like Advantage Link. Supports seamless data exchange and external process coordination.

transaction_type_processing_logic.description: Provides processing logic metadata for inventory transactions, including group identifiers and execution flow. Useful for orchestrating transaction sequences and advanced warehouse workflows.

warehouse_address.description: Address details for a specific warehouse

warehouse_master_data.description: Stores master data for each warehouse including identification, address, and regional attributes. Serves as a central reference for linking all warehouse-related activities.

active_warehouses.description: Filters and counts all currently active or operational warehouses.

warehouses_by_country.description: Lists all warehouses located in a specific country like Canada based on country_name.

warehouse_address_lookup.description: Retrieves full address and location details for a specific warehouse by name (e.g., Orbitor).

warehouse_count.description: Counts the total number of distinct warehouses defined in the system.

top_order_fulfillment_warehouse.description: Identifies the warehouse responsible for fulfilling the highest number of orders, based on order data.

pending_work.description: Work tasks that are pending or unassigned

batch_pick.description: Work type for batch pick tasks

time_due: CAST(time_due AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

work_queue_management.description: Manages real-time task queue for warehouse operations, including picking, putaway, replenishment, and cycle counting

work_queue_core_assignment.description: Tracks individual task assignments in the warehouse by linking work queue IDs to users and their current statuses. Helps ensure operational visibility and task accountability.

work_queue_labor_tracking.description: Supports real-time labor tracking and workforce management by monitoring who is assigned to what task. Enables workload balancing, exception handling, and productivity analysis across the warehouse floor.

warehouse_zones.description: Defines logical and operational zones within each warehouse for purposes like picking, replenishment, and putaway. Supports zone-based task routing, worker guidance, and inventory flow optimization.

zone_count_by_warehouse.description: Returns the number of distinct zones defined in a specific warehouse (e.g., warehouse 1), based on the zone names.

empty_zone_locations.description: Identifies all warehouse locations mapped to zones that are currently empty or unoccupied. Used for optimizing space allocation and task planning. Typically determined via joins with t_location or inventory tables.

zone_location_mapping.description: Maps each physical warehouse location to a functional zone and assigns a picking sequence to optimize zone-based picking, travel paths, and workload distribution.
